question: The total age of the 8 members of a family is 210 years. What will be their average age after 10 years?
solution: Now the average is 210 ÷ 8 = 26.25 years. After 10 years everyone is 10 years older: 26.25 + 10 = 36.25 years.
questionHi: एक परिवार के 8 सदस्यों की कुल आयु 210 वर्ष है। 10 वर्ष बाद उनकी औसत आयु क्या होगी?
solutionHi: अभी औसत 210 ÷ 8 = 26.25 वर्ष है। 10 वर्ष बाद हर सदस्य 10 वर्ष बड़ा होगा: 26.25 + 10 = 36.25 वर्ष।

question: The ages of two brothers are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their average age is 28 years. How old is the elder brother?
solution: Total age = 2 × 28 = 56. Shared 3 : 5, one part = 56 ÷ 8 = 7. The elder brother = 5 × 7 = 35 years.

question: The average age of 32 students and their teacher is 12 years. If the teacher's age is left out, the average falls by 0.5 years. How old is the teacher?
solution: All 33 together: 33 × 12 = 396. The 32 students: 32 × 11.5 = 368. Teacher = 396 − 368 = 28 years.

question: 2 years ago, the average age of a family of 3 members was 19 years. What is their average age now?
solution: In 2 years every one of the 3 members gets 2 years older, so the total rises by 3 × 2 and the average by 2: 19 + 2 = 21 years.
questionHi: 3 सदस्यों वाले एक परिवार की औसत आयु 2 वर्ष पहले 19 वर्ष थी। उनकी वर्तमान औसत आयु क्या है?
solutionHi: 2 वर्ष में 3 में से हर सदस्य 2 वर्ष बड़ा होता है, अतः कुल आयु 3 × 2 बढ़ती है और औसत 2: 19 + 2 = 21 वर्ष।

question: The average age of a mother and her daughter is 28 years. The mother is 26 years older than the daughter. How old is the daughter?
solution: Together they are 2 × 28 = 56 years. Taking away the 26-year gap leaves twice the daughter's age: (56 − 26) ÷ 2 = 15 years.
questionHi: एक माता और उसकी पुत्री की औसत आयु 28 वर्ष है। माता पुत्री से 26 वर्ष बड़ी हैं। पुत्री की आयु कितनी है?
solutionHi: दोनों की कुल आयु 2 × 28 = 56 वर्ष है। 26 वर्ष का अंतर हटाने पर पुत्री की आयु का दोगुना बचता है: (56 − 26) ÷ 2 = 15 वर्ष।
